Ex. A § 9.1 (emphasis added). Skold responds that the language of the mediation clause is permissive (“either Party may ... require”) and also argues that, in any event, Inc. has waived its right to invoke the clause because it participated in litigation over the dispute in the cancellation action before the TTAB. See United States v. Benish, 5 F.3d 20, 26 (3d Cir.1993) (rejecting a party’s claim where the party “provided] no legal support for his argument or any persuasive reason” for the court to find in his favor). IMG Worldwide, Inc., 360 F.Supp.2d 681, 687 (E.D.Pa.2005) (finding that a party’s engaging in motion practice and providing “substantial discovery” constituted waiver of contractual alternative dispute resolution provision).

                                               FARMOUT AGREEMENT


           FARMEE:        DAUGHERTY PETROLEUM, INC.
                          131 Prosperous Place, Suite 17-A
                          Lexington, KY 40509

           AREA:           5,400 acres, more or less
                          Artemus, Barbourville, Frakes and Kayjay Quads
                          Bell and Knox Counties, Kentucky

                   THISFARMOUTAGREEMENTDATED                  April 12          ,1996, (hereinafterreferred

           to as Agreement), is entered into by and between Equitable Resources Energy Company, a

           West Virginia Corporation, with offices at Two Executive Park Place, 1989 East Stone Drive,

           P. 0. Box 1983, Kingsport, Tennessee 37662-1983, (hereinafter called "Farmor") and the

           above named "Farmee", and shall be effective as hereinafter provided.

                   WHEREAS, Farmee agrees, concurrent with its execution of this Farmout Agreement,

           to pay Farmor, at Farmor's address herein, an initial location fee in the amount of Two

           Thousand Dollars ($2,000.00).

                   WHEREAS, subject to the terms and conditions set forth herein,Farmor agrees that

           Farmee may acquire an interest in the Farmout Lands described in Exhibit "A" and Exhibit "B"

           attached hereto and made a part hereof; provided, however, that Farmor expressly excepts

           and reserves unto itself all rights associated with those portions of Fee Tracts 5-1 162 and 5-

           1 163 lying within a 2000' radius circle surrounding Well KF-1053, which well is identified on

           the Exhibit "B" attached hereto.

                   NOW THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements

           hereinafter set forth, it is agreed by the parties as follows, to-wit:

           1.      EXHIBITS

                          The following exhibits are attached hereto and shall be considered part of this

                   Farmout Agreement:

                          Exhibit "A" -    Schedule describing the oil and gas lands subject hereto.

                          Exhibit "B" -    Plat of Farmout Lands.

                          Exhibit "B-1 "- Plat of Right of First Refusal acreage.

                          Exhibit "C" -    Geological Requirement Letter.

                          Exhibit "D" -    Agreement and Assignment of Operating Rights.

           2.      DEFINITIONS

                   (A)    A "completed well " is a well which has been fully equipped for the taking of

                          production through and including the tanks for an oil well and through and

                      including the christmas tree for a gas well, or plugged and abandoned, if a dry

                      hole.

               (B)    The term "drilling unit " means the area within the surface boundaries

                      established or prescribed by field rules or order of the applicable regulatory

                      authority, e.g. the spacing unit, unit for production, or proration unit.

               (C)    The term " earning well " means any well drilled under the terms and conditions

                      of this Agreement by which Farmee is entitled to receive an Agreement and

                      Assignment of Operating Rights.

                (D)   "Operating Rights Earned" are those rights earned, including the right to

                      operate, maintain and produce oil and/or gas from any well drilled hereunder,

                      including the right to produce oil and/or gas from that portion and only that

                      portion of the Farmout Lands lying in an Eighty (80) acre circle centered around

                      each gas well drilled which is capable of producing in paying quantities, and the

                      right to produce oil and/or gas from that portion and only that portion of the

                      Farmout lands lying within a Forty (40) acre circle centered around each oil well

                      drilled which is capable of producing in paying quantities. No operating rights

                      may be earned hereunder in or to those portions of Fee Tracts 5-1 162 and 5-

                      1163 lying within a 2000' radius circle centered around Well KF-1053.

                (E)   The term " lease burdens " means any royalty, overriding royalty, production

                      payment, and other similar burdens on production.

                (F)   " Contract Depth " shall be from the surface of the earth down to a depth of four

                      thousand feet (4,000').

                (G)   The term " test well " means the initial well drilled pursuant to the terms and

                      conditions contained herein.

                (H)   The term " shut-in well " means any well shut-in that has previously produced

                      and is still capable of producing in commercial quantities.

               (I)    The term " subseauent well " means any well drilled after the drilling and

                      completion of the initial test well.

               (J)    "Unearned Farmout Land" shall mean those lands covered by this Farmout

                      Agreement on which Operating Rights have not been earned by Farmee

                      pursuant to the terms and conditions hereunder.




                                                       2
 Case: 5:16-cv-00150-JMH-REW Doc #: 1-1 Filed: 05/19/16 Page: 4 of 18 - Page ID#: 29




                (K)   "Payout"     shall   be defined   as when the gross proceeds

                      attributable to the sale or production from a well equals the cost

                      of drilling, completing and equipping said well.

           3.   FARMOUT WELL/WELLS

                (A)   Farmee shall drill a well, hereinafter called the "test well" strictly in accordance

                      with the following well specifications:

                      (1)        Location: Farmee's choice on Farmout Land or on a drilling unit that

                                 includes all or a portion of Farmout Lands.

                      (2)        Spudding Deadline: On or before August 31, 1996, Farmee must

                                 commence the actual drilling of the test well at the location specified

                                 above.

                      (3)        Completion/Plugging Deadline:      Within forty-five (45) days after

                                 reaching total depth in the test well.

                (B)   Provided the "test well" herein is completed as a well capable of production in

                      paying quantities, or plugged and abandoned, Farmee shall have the option to

                      further develop and/or further explore the Farmout Lands by the drilling of

                      "Subsequent Wells" strictly in accordance with the following "Subsequent

                      Wells" specifications:

                      (1)        Location: Farmee's choice on Unearned Farmout Land or on a drilling

                                 unit that includes all or a portion of Unearned Farmout Lands.

                      (2)        Location Fee: Prior to the commencement of each Subsequent Well

                                 on Farmout Lands or on a drilling unit containing a portion of Farmout

                                 Lands, Farmee will promptly pay Farmor a location fee of Two

                                 Thousand Dollars ($2,000.00).

                      (3)        Spudding Deadline: On or before December 31, 1996, Farmee must

                                 commence the actual drilling of two (2) Subsequent Wells, (at the

                                 locations specified above) and, at Farmee's further option, it shall

                                 continuously develop the Farmout Lands by commencing the actual

                                 drilling of a minimum of two (2) Subsequent Wells per calendar year

                                 on the Farmout Lands or lands pooled therewith, beginning January 1,

                                 1997, and thereafter until the Farmout Lands subject hereto are fully

                              developed in accordance with the terms and conditions contained

                              herein.

                     (4)      Completion/Plugging Deadline: Within forty-five (45) days of reaching

                              total depth in each well.

               (C)   Substitute Well: In the event any well provided for herein is lost for any reason

                     prior to being drilled to Contract Depth or Farmee has encountered, during the

                     drilling of any well, mechanical difficulty or formation or condition which would

                     render further drilling impractical or impossible, Farmee may plug and abandon

                     such well and thereafter may continue its rights hereunder by commencing a

                     substitute well for any such well within thirty (30) days from the date the well

                     was lost or abandoned. Any substitute well drilled hereunder shall be drilled

                     subject to the same terms and conditions and to the same depth as provided

                     for the well so lost and abandoned.

               (D)   Assignment of Operating Rights - Produce to Earn: Upon receipt of Farmee's

                     written request and within sixty (60) days after Farmor is satisfied that Farmee

                     has complied with all its obligations (including but not limited to all geologic

                     requirements as set out in Exhibit "C") under this Agreement with regard to the

                     completion of a farmout well as a well capable of production in paying

                     quantities, Farmor shall deliver to Farmee:

                     (1)      An Agreement and Assignment of Operating Rights (in the form as set

                              out in Exhibit "D") of Farmor's interest in Operating Rights Earned.

                              Operating Rights Earned shall be defined for the test well and any

                              subsequent wells drilled hereunder in accordance with Section 2(D)

                              herein.

                     (2)      If the request for Assignment has not been received by the Farmor

                              within sixty ( 60) days after a well has been completed as a well

                              capable of production in paying quantities, Farmee forfeits its right to

                              receive the Assignment and shall promptly proceed to plug and

                              abandon any well situated upon the Farmout Lands in which Farmee

                              has failed to comply with the time frame contained herein.

                (E)   Depths Earned: The Operating Rights earned shall be from the surface of the

                      earth down to 100' below the total depth drilled, not to exceed a depth of four

                      thousand feet (4,000').

                (F)   Default By Farmee: Time being of the essence under this Agreement, in the

                      event Farmee fails to commence, continue drilling or complete any well in

                      accordance with the terms and conditions contained herein, this Agreement

                      shall terminate except as to those Operating Rights earned in accordance with

                      the terms and conditions as contained herein.

                                If Farmee defaults, other than above, in the timely and proper

                      performance of any obligations hereunder, Farmor shall have the right to

                      terminate this Agreement by giving Farmee thirty ( 30) days written notice to

                      cure such default.   In the event such default is not cured by Farmee within

                      thirty days of receipt of notice by Farmee, this Farmout Agreement shall

                      terminate except as to those Operating Rights Earned in accordance with the

                      terms and conditions contained herein and Farmee shall have no further rights

                      hereunder, but in no event shall Farmee be relieved of the obligation to plug and

                      abandon any wells drilled hereunder. Also, if Farmee defaults, in addition to

                      any other available legal or equitable remedies, Farmor may elect to take over

                      operation of (subject to the terms of Section 6 below) any well, inclusive of but

                      not limited to any well which is scheduled to be plugged and abandoned by the

                      Farmee,   which has not yet satisfied the earning requirements           of this

                      Agreement.    This Farmout shall remain in full force and effect as to those

                      Operating Rights Earned in accordance with the terms and conditions contained

                      herein.

           4.   RESERVED OVERRIDING ROYALTY INTEREST

                A.    Farmor shall except and reserve in each Agreement and Assignment of

                      Operating Rights earned hereunder an overriding royalty-interest equal to twelve

                      and one-half percent of eight eighth's (12.50% of 8/8) of the gross proceeds

                      received from the sale of oil and/or gas produced from wells drilled hereunder

                      without deductions of any kind.     Upon the Payout of the first two (2) wells

                      drilled and completed as a well capable of production in paying quantities

                      Farmor reserves the right to escalate the reserved overriding royalty of twelve

                      shall reserve in each Agreement and Assignment of Operating Rights earned

                      hereunder an overriding royalty equal to one and one-half percent (1.5%) of the

                      hereunder, without deductions of any kind, with the right to escalate said

                      overriding royalty to three and one-half percent (3.5%) upon payout of the first

                      two (2) wells drilled and completed as wells capable of production in paying

                      quantities and the right to escalate said reserved one and one-half percent

                      (1.5%) overriding royalty to six and one-half percent (6.5%) upon the Payout

                      of all other wells drilled and completed as wells capable of production in paying

                      quantities.   However, if Farmor's interest in the acreage is less than one

                      hundred percent (100%) or the working interest or if the Farmout acreage

                      contributes less than one hundred percent (100%) of the total unit acreage,

                      then said overriding royalty shall be reduced proportionately.     Any reserved

                      overriding royalty interest shall survive termination of this Agreement.

           5.   ABANDONMENT OF WELLS

                (A)   In the event any farmout well is completed as non-productive of oil or gas, or

                      as one not capable of producing oil and/or gas in paying quantities or ceases

                      production, Farmee shall immediately give Farmor written notice of the

                      proposed plugging and abandonment. For thirty (30) days after receipt of such

                      written notice, Farmor shall have the right, but not the obligation, to take over

                      the well for the purpose of conducting additional operations as it desires;

                      except that if a drilling rig is on location, notice to plug and abandon may be

                      given by telephone and Farmor's response period shall be limited to forty-eight

                      (48) hours, inclusive of Saturdays, Sundays and legal holidays.     In the event

                      Farmor fails to advise Farmee of its election within the prescribed period of

                      time, then Farmor shall be deemed to have elected not to take over such well

                           and such well shall be plugged and abandoned by Farmee in accordance with

                           the terms hereof.

                (B)        In the event Farmee plugs and abandons any well drilled on Farmout Lands

                           without written notification and Farmor's approval, or fails to give Farmor a

                           reasonable opportunity to consider its options as provided in Section 5(A)

                           hereof, this Agreement, as to the Unearned Farmout Lands, shall forthwith

                           terminate, and Farmee shall have no rights hereunder as to the Unearned

                           Farmout Lands, but Farmee shall, in any case remain responsible for the cost

                           of abandonment including but not limited to restoration and reclamation of the

                           surface acreage affected by the drilling of said well(s).

           6.   TAKEOVER BY FARMOR

                           If Farmor elects to take over a well under the terms and conditions of Section

                5. hereof, the effective date of the takeover shall be the date of approval of Farmor

                as the successor Operator under the applicable Commonwealth of Kentucky rules

                and/or regulations or when Farmor takes actual custody of the well, whichever is

                earlier.    As soon as practicable thereafter, Farmor shall reimburse Farmee for the

                estimated salvage value of Farmee's salvageable equipment in and on the well, less

                estimated plugging costs.        Farmee shall then execute an instrument of assignment

                conveying to Farmor its interest in said well and associated equipment. Farmee shall

                also assign to Farmor all of its right, title and interest, in and to, all leasehold, options,

                farmins, operating agreements, or other support agreements associated with the well

                and any Operating Rights Earned by Farmor and earned by Farmee pursuant to the

                terms and conditions hereunder.           Farmee shall then have no further rights or

                obligations under this Agreement in connection with the well being taken over by

                Farmor, except such rights, obligations and liabilities as accrued before the effective

                date of the Farmor's succession as Operator.

           7.   SHUT-IN/RENTAL PAYMENTS

                (A)        For any well drilled pursuant to this Agreement, that is located upon or pooled

                           with the Farmout Lands, and, which is capable of production (whether or not

                           Forty Five (45) days or longer; Farmee shall pay unto Farmor, a Shut-in Royalty

                           of Five Hundred Dollars ($500.00) per well per year, prorated on a monthly
